scientific_question: Does the independently validated v172 triple-isolated five-camera policy still provide a matched-accuracy exact-call advantage after its selected observations are physically reconstructed by one exact-adjoint H1 initializer and unchanged CGLS K1?
role: post-open end-to-end mechanism gate on nine opened reconstructed fields, thirteen opened calibrations, and four opened times; not fresh external evidence, not resource evidence, and not real BOST
physical_hypothesis: A geometry-selected five-camera observation can be lifted once by the exact adjoint into a fixed DCT-H1 initializer whose remaining error is removed by one unchanged CGLS step, while equal-or-cheaper classical starts and frozen camera-selection controls fail the same whole-field gate.

inputs.scope_boundary: all nine field models, thirteen calibrations, four times, and all candidate subset outcomes were already opened by v170-v172

selection_contract.primary: policy index 0 from the sealed v172 selection tensor
selection_contract.fit_static_control: policy index 1 from the same sealed v172 selection tensor
selection_contract.v169_fixed_geometry_control: policy index 2 from the same sealed v172 selection tensor
selection_contract.subset_mapping: indices address the lexicographically sorted canonical five-of-nine roster sealed by v170

initializer_contract.name: Exact-Adjoint DCT1023 H1 Fixed-0.03 Initializer
steps: call the selected exact operator adjoint once on the deployment observation
project that exact field-space lift onto the frozen orthonormal nonconstant DCT basis
solve the cached geometry-only generalized H1 system with multiplier 0.03
run unchanged identity-preconditioned CGLS K1 from that initializer
initializer_contract.h1_penalty: sum of squared physical DCT frequencies, normalized by its positive median

arms.primary: v172-primary subset + exact-adjoint H1 initializer + unchanged CGLS K1
arms.cheaper_initializer_control: v172-primary subset + exact-adjoint H1 initializer at K0
arms.same_budget_bp_control: v172-primary subset + normalized backprojection + CGLS K1
arms.same_budget_pcgls_control: v172-primary subset + geometry-sensitivity Jacobi PCGLS K2 with fixed relative floor 1e-6
arms.same_budget_fit_static_control: v172 fit-static subset + exact-adjoint H1 initializer + unchanged CGLS K1
arms.same_budget_v169_control: v169 fixed-geometry subset + exact-adjoint H1 initializer + unchanged CGLS K1

exact_call_ledger.geometry_cache: DCT basis projections, subset Grams, generalized spectra, and Jacobi diagonals are setup costs and must be reported separately from logical online calls
exact_call_ledger.offline_truth_observation: one forward per scored arm/subset is data construction only and cannot be counted as deployment speed evidence

matched_reference_gate.scope: primary-subset arms only; observation ratios are not compared across different camera subsets

control_gate.same_primary_subset_rule: a same-primary-subset control blocks only when it satisfies both the complete absolute gate and the identical matched-reference gate
control_gate.different_subset_rule: fit-static and v169 camera-policy controls block when they satisfy the complete absolute gate; their matched-reference ratios are diagnostic only because their observation coordinates differ

independent_recomputation.operator: independent sparse row builder and adjoint implementation inherited only from the independent v158 physics line
independent_recomputation.dct_basis: analytic tensor-product cosine basis rather than formal scipy idct basis
independent_recomputation.h1_solve: independent symmetric generalized eigensolve and direct exact-adjoint projection
independent_recomputation.solver: independent CGLS, normalized BP, and Jacobi-PCGLS recurrences; do not import the formal v173 runner or poolfire_c_baselines solver
required_checks: formal and independent selection tensors exact
468 cells per arm and 3744 total rows

decision_order: Any input, parent, selection, exact-adjoint, solver, call-accounting, numeric, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v173 inconclusive.
If the primary fails the complete absolute gate or matched Zero-CGLS K4 gate, conclude FAIL_CAMERA_SELECTED_WARM_REFINEMENT_V173 and close this fixed H1-plus-K1 integration.
If the primary passes but any equal-or-cheaper blocking control also passes, conclude FAIL_CLASSICAL_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_CAMERA_SELECTED_WARM_V173 and do not claim learned warm-start advantage.

Only if the primary passes both gates, every blocking control fails, all call receipts are exact, and independent recomputation agrees may v173 conclude PASS_CAMERA_SELECTED_WARM_REFINEMENT_HEADROOM_V173.

A pass authorizes only a separately frozen minimal shared-parameter observation/geometry predictor or fresh resource gate; it is not external generalization, algorithm breakthrough, paper success, curved-ray validation, or real BOST.
